sentences.text: If a company device is lost or stolen, report it within 2 hours of noticing, by email to security@lumenrobotics.example or through the 24 hour security hotline.
Report the loss even if you think the device was encrypted and the risk is low.
A replacement for a stolen laptop needs the approval of your director, who will usually ask for the police report number before ordering.
If a device is lost or stolen, you should also inform your manager.
